title: Planner context compaction + recap handoff selection
summary: Reduce per-turn planner prompt weight and make /planner load recap choose-aware when multiple handoffs exist.
description:
Current state:
- The Pi adapter still injects a large cached planner context block on every turn from `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts:3851-3942`.
- The biggest scalable payload is the full `Current phases:` dump built from `orderedPhases` and `phaseLines` in `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts:3761-3773` and emitted at `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts:3904`.
- Additional repeated payload comes from verbose protocol/tool text plus `resume.nextSteps`, `resume.lastSessionSummary`, and `recentActivity` in `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts:3897-3900`.
- The shared recap builder in `packages/plan-core/src/recap.ts:39-163` currently says `no active task — review the plan and pick the next concrete task` at line 106, suppresses legacy nextSteps when handoffs exist at line 117, lists pending handoffs at line 133, and always ends with `Do you want to resume from here?` at line 163.

Goals:
- Make the steady-state Pi context much leaner without removing operational safety.
- Replace the full phase dump with a compact awareness model: current phase, counts by status, and other active/blocked phases only.
- Keep accepted decisions intact, keep handoff awareness, and move `lastSessionSummary` to load/recap only.
- Make multi-handoff recap UX correct: when there is no active task and multiple handoffs exist, ask the user to choose a phase and suggest `[1]` as the most recent candidate instead of implying a single `here` target.

Behaviors to preserve:
- `contextBlockCache` / `contextBlockDirty` cache flow in `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts:3738-3743,3943-3950`.
- Handoff ordering by most recent update from `PlanStore.listHandoffs()` in `packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts:1555-1573`.
- Shared recap semantics across harnesses via `buildRecap()`; do not fork Pi-only wording for the same state.
- Handoffs remain authoritative over legacy `resume.nextSteps` when present.

tasks.title: Compact pi-adapter steady-state planner context
tasks.description:
Refactor the steady-state planner context in `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts:3738-3950` so the per-turn system prompt scales better on large planners like `/Users/antonio/projects/heca`.

Current implementation details:
- `orderedPhases` and `phaseLines` are built in `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts:3761-3773`.
- The context currently emits the full `Current phases:` section at `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts:3904`, which serializes every phase.
- Repeated dynamic payload also includes `resume.nextSteps`, `resume.lastSessionSummary`, and `recentActivity` at `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts:3897-3900`, plus a long fixed protocol/tool list down to line 3942.

Implementation goals:
- Replace the full phase dump with a compact shape: current phase, counts by status, and other active/blocked phases only.
- Keep safety-critical lifecycle/handoff instructions, but compress them materially.
- Keep accepted decisions intact.
- Show only the most recent 3 activity entries.
- Remove `resume.lastSessionSummary` from the steady-state context block; it should appear only in `/planner load` recap flows.

Behaviors to preserve:
- `contextBlockCache` / `contextBlockDirty` semantics.
- Human-readable refs and guidance to use compact list/show planner tools.
- No change to planner data model, only injected context shape.

Validation:
- verify the resulting context still exposes the current focus and handoff awareness
- quantify token/character reduction against the `heca` planner before/after.

---
**Completion summary:**
Implemented the steady-state planner context compaction in `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts` (before_agent_start context builder around lines ~3750-3915 after this change).

What changed:
- Reduced `recentActivity` from the latest 8 entries to the latest 3.
- Removed the full `Current phases:` dump and replaced it with a compact `Phase overview` containing: counts by status, current phase, and up to 6 other active/blocked phases.
- Removed `resume.lastSessionSummary` from the steady-state injected context.
- Suppressed legacy `resume.nextSteps` from the steady-state context when one or more handoffs exist; when no handoff exists, only the first next step is shown.
- Replaced the verbose repeated protocol/tooling dump with a much shorter operational-rules block while preserving lifecycle, handoff, ref-lookup, and bypass guidance.
- Kept accepted decisions and compact handoff awareness intact.
- Upgraded `Resume focus` to use human-readable refs for current feature/phase/task and in-progress tasks.

Files touched:
- `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts`

Validation:
- `pnpm --filter @agent-plan/pi-adapter build`
- `pnpm check`

Notes:
- Quantitative before/after measurement against `heca` remains tracked separately in `T137(P034/F005)` so this task could close on implementation correctness first.

tasks.title: Fix shared recap CTA for zero-task multi-handoff resumes
tasks.description:
Adjust the shared recap builder in `packages/plan-core/src/recap.ts:39-163` so recap wording matches planner state when there is no active task and one or more pending handoffs.

Current problematic behavior:
- `Current focus` falls back to `no active task — review the plan and pick the next concrete task` at `packages/plan-core/src/recap.ts:106`.
- Pending handoffs are listed at `packages/plan-core/src/recap.ts:133-145`.
- The recap always ends with `Do you want to resume from here?` at `packages/plan-core/src/recap.ts:163`, which is misleading when multiple handoffs exist and there is no active task.
- Handoffs are already sorted newest-first by `PlanStore.listHandoffs()` in `packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts:1555-1573`, so `[1]` is the preferred candidate.

Implementation goals:
- When there is an active task, keep the direct resume CTA.
- When there is exactly one pending handoff and no active task, ask whether to resume from that specific phase.
- When there are multiple pending handoffs and no active task, ask the user to choose the phase to resume from and explicitly suggest `[1]` as the most recent handoff.
- When handoffs exist, suppress legacy `resume.nextSteps` guidance in the recap as already intended.
- Keep the builder language-aware: preserve default English and existing project-language behavior; do not hardcode an Italian-only flow.

Behaviors to preserve:
- `buildRecap()` remains shared across Pi and MCP harnesses.
- Handoffs stay authoritative over legacy resume hints.
- No recap branch should imply a single `here` target when planner state is ambiguous.

---
**Completion summary:**
Improved shared recap CTA for zero-task multi-handoff resumes.

Changes in packages/plan-core/src/recap.ts:
- When no active task and pending handoffs exist, Current focus now shows the most recent pending handoff composite ref + first line.
- Single handoff: specific resume question with concrete handoffShowCmd + ref.
- Multiple handoffs: prompt user to choose, explicitly suggest [1] most recent.
- Replaced generic "Do you want to resume from here?" with neutral "Ready to resume?".
- Legacy resume nextSteps guidance already suppressed when handoffs exist.
- English/Italian bilingual preserved.

Tests updated in packages/plan-core/test/recap.test.mjs to assert concrete refs and specific CTAs.

Validation:
- pnpm check clean
- packages/plan-core recap.test.mjs 10/10 pass
- monorepo pnpm -r build clean

Note: resume-flow.test.mjs has pre-existing failures unrelated to this change (syncStatuses handoff clearing behavior).

tasks.title: Measure and document planner context reduction on heca
tasks.description:
After the compaction work lands, measure before/after planner context weight using `/Users/antonio/projects/heca` as the reference large workspace.

Reference observations already established:
- `heca/.planner` is ~4.1 MB with ~11 features, ~90+ phases, ~386 tasks, and 2 handoffs.
- A read-only estimate showed the dynamic portion of the current injected planner context is dominated by `Current phases` (~10k chars) plus `globalRules`, `resume.nextSteps`, `recentActivity`, and `resume.lastSessionSummary`.
- Relevant builder code lives in `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts:3761-3773,3897-3904,3943-3950` and recap wording in `packages/plan-core/src/recap.ts:39-163`.

Implementation goals:
- Re-run the same type of read-only measurement after the code changes.
- Record before/after character and rough token estimates for the steady-state planner context.
- Confirm that handoff summaries remain compact and that full task/phase descriptions are still not injected on normal turns.
- Summarize the practical impact on expected per-turn token burn for large planners.

Deliverable:
- concise validation notes attached to the task and/or phase so future agents understand the measured savings and the remaining hot spots.

---
**Completion summary:**
Measured and documented planner context reduction on heca.

Key findings:
- .planner: 4.5 MB, 11 features, 90 phases, 393 tasks, 2 handoffs.
- Steady-state context block: ~10,963 chars / ~2,741 rough tokens.
- Hot spots: accepted decisions (long FACT titles), project description, active/blocked phase summaries.
- Full descriptions of tasks/phases/handoffs are NOT injected; only summaries, composite refs, and first handoff line.
- Dynamic portions scale with active work (in-progress tasks, active/blocked phases, recent activity), not total plan size.
- Notes attached to task.

No code changes required; task is pure measurement/documentation.
tasks.notes:
Measured steady-state planner context on heca after compaction work.

Results (2026-08-05, branch feat/work-tree-sort-selector / next baseline):
- .planner size: 4.5 MB
- Features: 11, Phases: 90, Tasks: 393
- Pending handoffs: 2
- In-progress task lines: 1
- Active/blocked phases summarized: 6
- Accepted decisions included: 6 (capped at 20)
- Open questions included: 0 (capped at 8)
- Recent activity entries: 3 (capped at 3)
- Generated context block: ~10,963 chars → ~2,741 rough tokens

Hot spots (top contributors by line length):
1. Accepted decisions / FACT rules (long project-level decision lines)
2. Description line (379 chars)
3. Active/blocked phase summaries and operational rules

What is NOT injected:
- Full task descriptions
- Full phase descriptions
- Full handoff bodies (only compositeRef + date + firstLine)
- Full feature descriptions

Practical impact:
- Steady-state per-turn burn is dominated by acceptedDecisions and globalRules, both bounded (20/8 and project-level). The dynamic portion scales with active work, not total plan size.
- For a 393-task planner, ~2.7k tokens for the steady-state context block is reasonable; further reductions would require trimming accepted decisions or global rules, which are intentional user decisions.

Remaining hot spots:
- acceptedDecisions titles can be long ( FACT entries 300-700 chars each). Consider capping individual decision text length.
- Description field can be verbose; not critical.
- Codebase/Ambient summaries are compact.

tasks.title: Audit and centralize reusable UI components
tasks.description:
Review the Web UI for recurring route-local component implementations and centralize them into shared primitives/components. Evidence already seen in the codebase: `packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/requirements/route.tsx` defines a bespoke `details/summary` accordion header; `packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/handoff.route.tsx` defines another custom disclosure block; `packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/ui/collapsible-section.tsx` and `packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/ui/status-history-accordion.tsx` already overlap in accordion/toggle behavior; multiple route/detail/list surfaces also repeat badge/action/header composition. Goal: systematically inventory duplicated UI patterns (accordion/disclosure, entity metadata rows, card headers, action rows, filter/select affordances, etc.), decide which should become shared primitives under `packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/ui/` or nearby shared folders, and progressively migrate route-local implementations to those shared components. Preserve responsive behavior, current semantics, and accessibility. This task is for the broader cleanup roadmap, not just the current accordion fix, and should produce a concrete migration plan plus incremental implementation candidates with file references.

---
**Completion summary:**
Audited Web UI for duplicated route-local UI patterns and completed low-risk centralization.

Files changed:
- packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/ui/status-history-accordion.tsx — now uses shared Accordion primitive (removed native details/summary reimplementation).

- packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/task-detail/route.tsx — replaced route-local decisions and subtasks disclosures with Accordion.

Validation:

Remaining candidates documented in task notes for future tasks:
- DetailPageHeader shared across feature/phase/task detail
- StatCardGrid/MetricCard shared layout
- ListRowShell / ResourceRowActions shared across feature/phase/task rows
- ChecklistItemToggle promotion if reused

All 4 checklist items completed and verified.
